summary: Carapace size/shape/ornamentation data for extant clam shrimps are open (Dryad 10.5061/dryad.fbg79cnxs, CSV tables plus per-species archives, CC0), and Spinicaudata occurrences exist in PBDB (165 occurrences) and iDigBio (Cyzicidae, 2,328 records). I found no section, CT or time-series data showing retained moults, and MorphoSource and the BioImage Archive returned nothing for Spinicaudata. The name Estheria resolves in GBIF to a Cyzicidae synonym but also to a fly genus, so searches by name mix taxa.
next_step: Open the Dryad Data_S*.csv headers and Species_*.zip contents to see whether growth-line positions are recorded; for the mechanism itself compile sectioned-carapace images from the literature.
obstacles_confirmed: External lines alone cannot separate retained moults from true shell accretion; sections are mostly in papers.
Estheria is a historical name now split among modern genera and shared with a fly genus in GBIF and iDigBio.
